Questions

Good to know.

Do you deliver to offices in Dubai Silicon Oasis?

Yes. We deliver every morning to offices and business centres across DSO, so lunch is sorted before the workday starts.

Do you deliver to RIT Dubai and DSOA University Residence?

Yes. We deliver every morning to RIT Dubai students, including DSOA University Residence and other student housing in Silicon Oasis.

Can our team get a meal plan together?

Yes. We offer monthly office meal plans for teams. Message us on WhatsApp with your team size and office location.

How much is a meal plan in Silicon Oasis?

Weekly plans cost AED 215, 415 or 610 for 1, 2 or 3 meals a day. Monthly plans cost AED 715, 1,400 or 1,999, which is AED 25.63 to 30.71 per meal.
